Customer ne website par enquiry bhari. Aapko pata hi nahi chala. 😬

Do din baad aapne dekha, tab tak wo kisi aur ko kaam de chuka tha. Aaj har customer 3 4 jagah enquiry karta hai, aur order usi ko milta hai jo pehle jawab de.

Ise kehte hain Silent Form. Theek karne ke 3 step:
1️⃣ Form chhota rakhiye: naam, phone, zaroorat. Bas.
2️⃣ Submit ke baad likhiye: hum aaj hi call karenge.
3️⃣ Har enquiry seedhe aapke WhatsApp par aaye, aur ek sheet mein save ho.

Aaj hi test kariye: apni website ka form khud bhariye. Alert 5 minute mein nahi aaya, to aap customers kho rahe hain.

Save kar lijiye, aur us bande ko bhejiye jo aapki website sambhalta hai. 📩

Aapke paas enquiry ka alert kahan aata hai: email, WhatsApp, ya kahin nahi? Comment mein bataiye 👇
